messages.content:
Hey @everyone ! Thank you all for the interest in the game, I really appreciate it. 
Today is the last day of closed beta, which we planned to close in no more than 12 hours from now. So, for that reason, **I am not giving any further keys**. We already know that the main issue with the game is the map, which isn't big enough to hold the current demand. Like I have explained many times, the Apogea you're playing is a small sample (15%) of what the game is supposed to be - we put it online because we had no idea anyone would actually be interested in the game. So now that we know that, we can start working on the real thing.
The server will have more tests that will be announced once we think we can handle more players, so, please, be patient 🙏 
I will also be posting constant updates about what we're working on to let you guys in the development process.
Thank you all for helping us test the game. It was an amazing opportunity to form new connections with the community 🫡 
Also please check the <#1273297774523191378> and the <#1274041587168575562> where you can learn more about the game.

@everyone Sorry for the random tag, but, can you give me a simple 👍  or 👎  on this idea?

**A 5$ Patreon for Apogea, which gives you:**
- +1 extra stress test day. Stress tests will usually be done during Saturday and Sunday, but you get to login on Friday.
- A special reward that we will collectively design (outfit? pet? item? title?) that will be added to the Patreon supporter's account on release
- Something else? (Make a suggestion) 

The special reward is on top of the beta tester reward, which the <@&388859627116167169> role will already get 🫡 
By the way, if you're wondering why I'm **suggesting** this, check out our conversation on <#1277610826202878036>

@everyone Please check out our Patreon! https://www.patreon.com/Apogea
Ask me anything about it or give me feedback here on Discord - I will also very soon update it with the roadmap and other useful things.
By the way, if you can't help us with Patreon, **its not a big deal**, your support is already very valuable 🫡
<@&358970663635255296> <@&388859627116167169>

# Last Hours of Test 🕐 
The time has come! Even though we decided to keep the servers on for a bit longer, we will shut it down in a few hours.
It was a great test, as always, and you guys have helped us immensely! 
Thanks to our bug-detection tool, we fixed a lot of bugs we didn't even knew existed <:poggin:1289734879545655357> 

# Apogea Rules 📖 
Additionally, I would like to show you all our new <#862137659098660914> , and would love for you to give us some input into what you think about it.
Each rule has a discussion opened where everyone can chime in and give their opinions.

# Next test and PvP ⚔️ 
About the next test, sadly we will have to delay the "North and Axe" update to January/Februrary, due to how tight our schedule has been the past month.
Instead, we will replace it with a PvP test, focused on testing how the Player versus Player actually works in Apogea.
To make this work, we will make all of your progress **not** be saved - and allow you to get a "papaya" bonus to level your character.
Also, the death penalty will be completely removed - to encourage more PvP to happen... And progress after level 30 will be halted, giving no experience.

*I will open a discussion here for you guys to give us some thoughts about this.*

# Keys and Steam 🔐 
About the keys and allowing new testers to join, we are currently working out a solution with Steam to allow for a big test to happen.
Hopefully, by mid December, we will have a new module of testing on Steam that will allow me to distribute access more freely

And, as always, thank you all for supporting us in making the game the best it could be 🫡

Thank you and I will see you there! 🫡

messages.content:
Hey everyone, just letting you know that you should not worry, the development is going fine.
The reason for our disappearing is that this time around our workload is a bit bigger than expected, mainly due to the fact we're pushing a bit further towards game completion.
Hopefully you can understand this and I appreciate those of you that have been patient.
Soon enough we will have a more solid ground to announce the test's date.
Don't lose hope, we're getting there <:pepepray:1289719258967834767>

-# @everyone 
I'm announcing the test date:
# <t:1768575600>

**If you're wondering why such a late date, please read this 👇 **

I know the wait has been hard and asking for these extra days sounds rough, but unfortunately we need the time to make sure all of the new content we added is working properly and is polished, because this time we added a lot of new things.

Just to give a bit of reference, we essentially **doubled **the amount of items and map size while adding multiple new mechanics and traits to the game.
We thought it was the correct timing due to how well last test went, so we're pushing to get the game semi-ready for release, making this upcoming test very likely the final one, where we just make sure everything's working as intended, before going live officially.

So, a few weeks before this test I will do yet another announcement to give instructions for Patrons on how to connect to the day-first-exclusive servers. 
(*All Patrons that subbed on: **June, July, August, September, October, November, December or January** will be eligible for that.*)

On that note, me and the team want to **thank all the Patrons that have been supporting us still and have not given up on Apogea!** 
Your help has been incredible and has allowed us to add this ton of new content to the game, without you, things would have been a lot of different.

And that's it, sorry to keep you waiting and I'm looking forward to share everything we've made so far with you. 
Don't lose hope, Apogea is coming soon!

||Also I'm leaving you with a tiny spoiler of a new area that I just think is cool||
